messages:
Priya: Quick thread on autofallback UX: should automatic fallback require manual confirmation before returning traffic? Pros/cons?
Owen: lean auto-return but only after a stability window + SLO checks. Manual hold for high-severity incidents.
Hana: We need immutable audit rows for every state change (system->fallback, hold, resume). Compliance asks for CSV export.
tj-bot: I can emit audit rows and attach telemetry links when events occur.
Priya: Inbox design idea: operator sees compact card with reason, affected route, cost delta, 3 actions: [Ack], [Hold until resumed], [Open details]. If no action and severity low -> auto-return after configured window.
Owen: Show "why this target" (compat, quant, perf) in details. Also attach up to 5 scrubbed samples for quick debugging.
Hana: Add rate-limit on ack/hold API and RBAC so only ops/release roles can hold in prod. Staging can be looser.
Priya: Telemetry tagging: fallback_id + fallback_reason on requests so analytics can slice. We'll also include token_cost per request.
Owen: Add hysteresis: require N stable minutes without triggers before reenable, not just timer. Prevent flapping.
Priya: I'll mock inbox + timeline view (filters: model, route, trigger). Will include one-click export: postmortem bundle (CSV + samples + traces).
Hana: Planning a staging sim next week to validate flow. I'll draft CSV schema.
Priya: Cool, posting mock by EOD Friday. End thread.
